english.title: Fail to hand in property found at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having found property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..), on a part of Bristol Airport to which the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 apply, failed to hand it, as soon as reasonably practicable and in the state in which you found it, to a member of staff of the Airport, an Airport Official or Constable and inform that person of the place and circumstances in which it was found
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
